subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR’s CLI-only `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` contract, including the user-facing stderr/JSON shape and exit-code behavior, as the product direction for blocked session lanes?
rationale: The source-reproducible bug is clear, but the permanent CLI/API contract and exit-code behavior affect operator scripts, and the open fix PR already carries compatibility/message-delivery review risk.

options.title: Accept the linked PR contract
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90933 once its draft/waiting state and merge risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep exit code 1
options.body: Ask the PR to preserve the existing exit-code contract while only surfacing the lane-busy diagnostic and retry guidance.

options.title: Choose a broader lane policy
options.body: Pause the linked PR and keep this issue open for a wider session-lane admission design instead of a CLI surfacing fix.

recommendation.title: Accept the linked PR contract
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90933 once its draft/waiting state and merge risks are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available current-main routing owner from the checked-out history for the CLI/Gateway/session-lane surfaces, although the shallow history limits confidence.
